notes: Today, we will be breaking down pet care giant, Petco. Founded in 1965 as a mail-order business, Petco has evolved into a one-stop-shop pet care solution across its nearly 1,500 locations. To help break down Petco, I am joined by Greg Kamstra, current CEO of pet care provider, Riverdog and former private equity investor. We will discuss how Petco evolved into its current big-box model, how pet care store economics differ from grocery economics, and what impact e-commerce has had on the industry. It’s always fascinating to learn about secular growth stories, and the pet care industry falls into that category. I hope you enjoy this breakdown of Petco.  Introduction

Today we will be breaking down pet care giant Petco. Founded in 1965 as a mail order business, Petco has evolved into a one-stop shop pet care solution across it's nearly 1,500 locations. To help break down Petco, I am joined by Greg Kamstra, current CEO of pet care provider Riverdog and former private equity investor. We will discuss how Petco evolved into its current big box model, how pet care store economics differ from grocery economics and what impact e-commerce has had on the industry. It's always fascinating to learn about secular growth stories and the pet care industry falls into that category. I hope you enjoy this breakdown of Petco.
